items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: There was a first trumpet player named Fats Ford, who later changed his name to Merenghito... I took the bus back uptown to get my bag, came back on the bus, and got on the bus with the band.

ctx.x: Well we know Philly. It’s something “-town,” I think. Anyhow, they needed a drummer, and I was there. I lived in Sugar Hill then. I took the bus back uptown to get my bag, came back on the bus, and got on the bus with the band. There was a first trumpet player named Fats Ford, who later changed his name to Merenghito. He was playing with a lot of Spanish bands up in the mountains later, and he was speaking Spanish and smoking his cigars. I don’t know if they have too much drum music, and you don’t have time to…
It was how long? One week?
